Chapter 1258: Chapter 15: A World of Despair (Subscription Requested)_2

“Turning into a demon? Essentially, it’s nothing more than using the cultivator as a vessel to cultivate a powerful ‘demon’.”

Lin Yuan thought of Qingyun Sect’s assessment of those who turn into demons.

Qingyun Sect is a traditional cultivation force, absolutely prohibitive of turning into demons. At first, turning into a demon can indeed gain a powerful strength boost.

But as time progresses, the erosion by demonic qi worsens, the minds of those who have turned into demons will quickly become distorted, further drawing closer to becoming a true ‘demon’.

…

“The urgent task now is how to deal with Brother Li.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, his expression solemn.

Brother Li eroded the ‘true self’ with demonic qi, aiming to silence and prevent the incident of him turning into a demon from spreading.

Once he discovers I’m not dead, he surely won’t let it go.

“Brother Li is the senior disciple of Qingyun Sect, possessing Lord-level strength. In my current state, I’m no match.”

Lin Yuan shook his head lightly.

What’s more, after turning into a demon, Brother Li’s strength will surge significantly, likely rivalling the Chaos Realm.

In such circumstances, facing Brother Li’s murderous intent, Lin Yuan has no ability to resist.

Unless he uses the World-Breaking Origin Force.

But the World-Breaking Origin Force is a method that definitely should not be used if it can be avoided; it’s a trump card of trump cards.

Especially when unclear about the depth of this Fang Yuan World, rashly using the World-Breaking Origin Force might bring unforeseen consequences.

“Forget it.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, immediately contacting Elder Fang who had just left.

“What is it?”

Elder Fang quickly appeared again, looking at Lin Yuan, “Recovering well, why are you looking for me?”

“Elder Fang, I have a major matter to report to the Sect Leader.”

Lin Yuan was certain, Elder Fang likely wasn’t on Brother Li’s side, otherwise, the moment he woke up, Brother Li would know, and would probably have already arrived.

Thus, Elder Fang could be trusted.

“A major matter?”

Elder Fang glanced at Lin Yuan, “What major matter?”

“A matter related to demons.”

Lin Yuan said.

Under the circumstance of definitely not being a match for Brother Li, the only reliance could be Qingyun Sect.

“Demons?”

Elder Fang’s expression turned solemn.

Lin Yuan had already been injured by a demon, this statement had some persuasive power to Elder Fang.

At least it wasn’t baseless.

“Are you sure it’s a major matter? For ordinary matters, disturbing the Sect Leader means punishment.” Elder Fang reminded.

Most of the time, the Sect Leader of Qingyun Sect is in seclusion, used to increase strength, facing repeated major demon mountain attacks.

“I’m sure.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“If that’s the case, come with me.”

Elder Fang immediately planned to take Lin Yuan with him.

“Elder Fang.” Lin Yuan said, “This matter is very important, absolutely must not be leaked.”

Lin Yuan worried that Elder Fang might unintentionally reveal it to Brother Li, adding unnecessary variables.

“Rest assured.”

Elder Fang glanced at Lin Yuan, “I know what’s important.”

Regardless of whether Lin Yuan truly has a major matter, before the Sect Leader confirms, Elder Fang definitely won’t say anything outside.

“Follow me.”

Elder Fang led Lin Yuan and stepped out.

Space-time transformed.

In an instant, they arrived at a grand hall.

Above the hall sat a middle-aged man wearing a green robe.

At this moment, the middle-aged man opened his eyes and looked towards Elder Fang and Lin Yuan.

“Sect Leader.”

Elder Fang slightly bowed, briefly recounting Lin Yuan’s situation.

“What is the matter?”

The Qingyun Sect Leader looked at Lin Yuan, speaking calmly.

“Sect Leader.”

Lin Yuan glanced at Elder Fang standing next to him.

“I’ll leave first.”

Elder Fang hesitated slightly, then immediately turned and left.

For a moment, only Lin Yuan and the Qingyun Sect Leader remained in the grand hall.

“Go ahead, what is the matter.”

The Qingyun Sect Leader spoke.

“Brother Li has already turned into a demon.”

Lin Yuan didn’t beat around the bush, directly saying.

“Qing’er has fallen into demonic influence?”

The Qingyun Sect Leader’s pupils narrowed as he stood up from the throne.

“How do you know this?”

The Qingyun Sect Leader squinted slightly, making the surrounding space-time feel subtly oppressive.

Li, the Master Brother Li Qing of the Qingyun Sect, was being groomed as the future Sect Leader. Lin Yuan’s direct claim that Master Brother had fallen into demonic influence was naturally not believed by the Sect Leader.

“The reason I was eroded by the Demonic Qi was precisely because I detected Master Brother absorbing and devouring Demonic Qi.” Lin Yuan looked at the Qingyun Sect Leader and began to speak.

The Qingyun Sect Leader did not respond, merely looking quietly at Lin Yuan.

“Sect Leader, if this is false, I am willing to accept any punishment.”

Lin Yuan said.

“I understand.”

The Qingyun Sect Leader closed his eyes.

…

Yuqing Hall.

This is the grand hall of the Master Brother of the Qingyun Sect, second only to the Sect Leader’s residence.

At this moment, within the grand hall, Li Qing sat cross-legged.

“To preserve the legacy of the Qingyun Sect, I must rely on the power of demons.”

Li Qing thought silently. As the Master Brother of the Qingyun Sect, he desired more than anyone else for the sect to continue its legacy.

However, the demons in the world grew ever more numerous and powerful, and traditional cultivators found it increasingly difficult to resist them. The last attack by a Great Demon had nearly exhausted the foundation of Qingyun Mountain.

Li Qing was well aware of the risks of falling into demonic influence, but it was the fastest way to enhance his power, without a doubt.

“Hmm?”

At this moment, Li Qing was astonished to find that the array in Yuqing Hall suddenly shifted space-time, and an overwhelming Power of Space-Time came down to suppress him.

“Not good!”

Li Qing’s expression changed dramatically. He wanted to charge out, but was imprisoned tightly by the pervasive power of the array.

“Master?”

Li Qing found it hard to believe. Only the Qingyun Sect Leader—his master—could control the entire array of the Qingyun Sect.

Rustle.

Space-time shifted.

Li Qing was instantly brought outside of the grand hall.

He saw the Qingyun Sect Leader high above, standing beside him was Lin Yuan.

“You’re not dead?”

In Li Qing’s eyes, there was incredulity as he realized Lin Yuan had survived the erosion of Demonic Qi.

“Qing’er, stop resisting.”

The Qingyun Sect Leader looked at Li Qing and said, “As long as I can confirm you have no ties with the demons.”

Although the Qingyun Sect Leader did not believe his disciple would fall into demonic influence, matters such as this had to be approached with the worst-case scenario in mind.

After all, letting him be thoroughly checked wasn’t a bad thing.

“Master.”

Li Qing looked at the Qingyun Sect Leader, his tone a bit complex: “I have indeed fallen into demonic influence.”

The moment he saw Lin Yuan, Li Qing realized that his secret of falling into demonic influence couldn’t be concealed anymore.

With matters of this magnitude, no matter who said it, the Qingyun Sect Leader had to confirm it personally.

“Qing’er, you?”

The Qingyun Sect Leader slightly shook his head, a tinge of sadness in his expression: “Do you not understand what falling into demonic influence means?”

“Master, I do.”

Li Qing nodded: “But I also know that if I do not fall into demonic influence, how long can our Qingyun Sect withstand the next Great Demonic Attack?”

“Master, you should be aware that with the current foundation of our Qingyun Sect, even if we withstand the next Great Demonic Attack, what about the time after that? And the time after that?”

“Not falling into demonic influence, Qingyun Sect will eventually be unable to withstand the Great Demon, but by falling into demonic influence, the Qingyun Sect has a slim chance of survival.”

Li Qing said.

“Falling into demonic influence will only create an even stronger demon for this world.” The Qingyun Sect Leader shook his head and said.

“Master, you have to believe me, I can definitely resist the influence of Demonic Qi.” Li Qing said urgently.

“Li Qing, you are already influenced by Demonic Qi.” The Qingyun Sect Leader’s gaze filled with disappointment as he waved his hand.

Rumble.

The majestic Power of Space-Time crushed toward Li Qing, wielding the power of the Qingyun Sect’s Mountain Protection Array, almost reaching the perfect Chaos Realm level.

“Master, you don’t believe me, you don’t believe me!”

In Li Qing’s eyes, a pitch-black Demonic Qi burst forth, attempting to erode the surrounding Power of Space-Time.

But clearly.

The current Li Qing was no match for the Qingyun Sect’s Mountain Protection Array, and he was soon worn down to nothing.

The current Master Brother of the Qingyun Sect, the most hopeful disciple to step into the Chaos Realm, thus perished.

Lin Yuan stood beside the Qingyun Sect Leader, quietly watching this scene.

The things Li Qing said were indeed true; Lin Yuan also felt that Li Qing fell into demonic influence genuinely to save the Qingyun Sect.

Otherwise, with Li Qing’s status as the senior disciple of the Qingyun Sect, the future Sect Leader, with infinite prospects, even if one day the Qingyun Sect truly fell to the Great Demon, Li Qing could still escape.

“This world…”

Lin Yuan felt more profoundly the despair faced by the creatures of this Fang Yuan World.
